name: bloorush-monorepo
description: BlooRush App Ecosystem: Client App, Partner App & Web Admin Console

scripts.build:all: npm run build:client && npm run build:partner
scripts.cap:client:sync: npm run build:client && cd apps/client && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:partner:sync: npm run build:partner && cd apps/partner && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:all: npm run cap:client:sync && npm run cap:partner:sync
scripts.cap:client:android: npm run build:client && cd apps/client && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:partner:android: npm run build:partner && cd apps/partner && npx cap open android
